meta.description: Mewvo is a Discord bot for moderation with case codes and DMs, a three-step warning ladder, appeals that reach a person, automod, tickets and community tools.
meta.title: Mewvo: moderation and community bot for Discord

actions.openDashboard: Mewvo already in your server? [Open the dashboard]({url})

hero.title: A Discord bot for moderation and appeals
hero.lead: Mewvo warns, mutes, kicks and bans from one panel. The member gets a DM with the reason, the end time and how to appeal. Your staff get a case with a short code they can look up later.
hero.notPublic: Mewvo runs on the Mewvo server for now. It can’t be added to other servers yet.
hero.dmCaption: The DM a member gets for a second warning. Same wording as the bot.

dashboard.title: Everything in one place
dashboard.text: Members, cases, appeals and every setting in the browser. Sign in with Discord; every change is in an audit log. [A tour of the dashboard](/docs/using-the-dashboard)
dashboard.shotAlt: The Mewvo dashboard overview: items that need staff, moderation over the last seven days, bot health and setup progress.

ladder.title: The same rules for everyone
ladder.text:
Warnings climb a fixed ladder per member and server. Two warnings are a DM. The third is a 7-day ban, then 30 days, then permanent. Manual bans don’t move it, and an accepted appeal moves it back down a step.

Members can check where they stand, so nobody is surprised by a ban. [How warnings escalate](/docs/warnings)

what.title: What it does
what.text: Moderation first, with the community tools a server needs next to it. [Every feature](/features)

enforcement.name: Moderation
enforcement.text: Warn, mute, kick and ban from one panel that shows the member’s history first. Every action is a case with a short code that staff can edit, remove if it was a mistake, or add evidence to later.

appeals.name: Appeals
appeals.text: Members appeal with a short form, in Discord or on this website, and the staff of the server that punished them decide. The website works even after a ban, when the member shares no server with Mewvo any more.

automod.name: Automod
automod.text: Fourteen rules, from scam links to mass mentions. Each automatic action is a normal case, with a card in the staff channel to keep, undo or change it.

tickets.name: Tickets and modmail
tickets.text: A ticket panel, and members can DM the bot to reach staff. Both become channels in your server; lines starting with // stay internal.

logging.name: Logging and tools
logging.text: Joins, leaves, role changes, edited and deleted messages and more, each in the channel you choose. Verification and server tools sit next to it.

community.name: Community tools
community.text: Leveling, tags, suggestions, starboard, sticky messages, YouTube feeds, reaction roles, giveaways, birthdays, applications, join-to-create voice channels, welcome messages.

pricing.title: Free to use
pricing.text: Everything above is free. Paid plans only raise limits such as tags and sticky messages. [Plans and prices](/pricing)

help.title: Questions?
help.text: Start with the [docs](/docs) or the [questions and answers](/faq).
help.support: Still stuck? Ask in the [support server]({url}); a person answers.
